Hello! It's wonderful that you've already found some favorites and like caro, hope you've been enjoying the game so far!

It's rather unorthodox but it's very fun (and funny) to play a dps Caraboo build, as her "snowy hex" does a good amount of damage with bonus weakness, if you invest into her e3 her exalt has great damage potential while doubling as a great support for your secondary/main dps! I highly suspect snowy hex should hold up until chapter 7-8 (the "dream of medicine" covenant from the badges shop is very worth the investment!)

There are a handful of characters who have synergy with each other (like bird twins, poison duo, lemuria), but majority of the time it's just identifying what a character *benefits from* then matching them with a character that leans into it, opposed from conflicting or making up for any weaknesses in the team (for example pcaro has survival issues, so additional healing + death res is necessary)

Arc 1 is very forgiving and for most of the stages, you can use any combo of characters and newest release characters are especially powerful. You will eventually figure out what works the more you play, or build your team around a specific stage (I had ~3 different "main" teams playing through arc 1 to counter certain enemies/stages)

The "meta" is constantly shifting and each chapter (even each stage!) has a totally different approach that's more effective, so there isn't exactly a "perfect endgame team" but rather slight adjustments or switching between teams based on the situation!

Last thing I will say is that covenants/relics are often overlooked but they make a huge difference (I have a guide for those but cheri's handbook goes over a lot!)

Sorry for the wall of text but I hope it's of any help and lmk if there's anything that needs clarifying or more questions! Have fun and good luck <:Agrippa_hug:1356083899553288382>

content:
Hello there and welcome aboard <:Saya_yum:1513124263291387975> 

The first chapters are forgiving enough that you can fiddle a bit with your linups and try a lot of different gameplays.
I certainly encourage you try at least all four realms as you will eventually want 5 teams ( 19 awakeners ).

About consumable : I recommand you check their expiry date and wait as lon as you reasonably can so you have a bit of time to better understand what suits you most.

Teams : I say just pick 1 awakener you live, add another then fill the blanks. When you hit a wall we will help you overcome it.

What matters most, besides synergy and countering the ennemy, is awakener level.
You can get them all to lv 40 without too much effort and lvl 60 with some time.
Don't forget to up their skill levels either.

Morimens is a game about trial and error so losing is totally fine as long as you take something away from the loss : boss pattern, mechanics, keywords, ...

Finally, pulls.
You'll get loads of pure core so you can just spend these as you like when you want.
Etheral cores are used for lilited banners, usually featuring efficient awakeners.
But wether they suit you or not is entirely dependant on your own playstyle so do give them a trial run first by borrowing from a whale in the current event.
Did you find Cheri's handbook ? If you didn't, just type /new

She's actually rather easy to use :
- Play eternal loom whenever you draw it. It inflicts final verdict that stacks until it reaches current health and kills the enemy when it does.
> Bypasses shield and immunity
- When her exalt is ready, use it before any command card if
> The current turn is ultra turn + you stacked some weave
or
> You annihilated a card ( took it out from ultra space ) + you stacked some weave

The guiding strings is more tricky. You need to play them to get weave stacks but you lose some health, increasing each time.
If you discard them, Atachne will instead get some aliemus

Borrowing from a whale is a legit strategy : )

Do mind that awakener level matters a lot in this game. If you can't use max-Mouchy to nuke the boss, you might want to boost your own units to provide support.

Survivability can be enhanced with caro realm ( free heal scaling with lost HP ), æquor ( free shield scaling with each turn you don't change the tentacle stance ), shielders ( Arachne, Winkle, Corposant, Lily, ... ), healers ( Salvador, Celeste, Clementine, Faint, Karen, ... ), debuffers ( Thaïs, Clementine, Karen, Corposant, ... )

Celeste and Faint are specific in the way Celeste gives a free death res ( once per encounter or every 6 turns if you enlighten her ) and Faint gives you extra death res on exhalt
